report:
Reviewed the complete relative_composition claim, all five ordinary implementation associations, both annotated tests, and captured parser/CST/function-body dependencies. Requirements: a source-root item has an absolute range in exactly one ParseSource; associated definitions have placements relative to their immediate represented trait/impl owner; signature and body CST offsets are reset to the associated definition start; typed nodes retain that definition-relative coordinate system; absolute resolution adds the intervening placement and preserves source identity. parse/util.rs absolute_span stores the passed source and item start/end; parse/items.rs source-root constructors use it. parse_associated_items calculates placement against the owner item_start, then passes child_start to function/type/const CST construction. Those builders pass the same child origin into signatures and body parsing. Captured parse/types.rs and parse/exprs.rs subtract that origin from syntax byte positions. TraitItemCst explicitly stores the placement separately from its CST. associated.rs lower_item resolves each placement against owner_span for all three associated kinds. span.rs AbsoluteSpan::resolve adds self.start to both relative endpoints and copies self.source, so resolving owner then definition-relative node composes the offsets. Function body checking uses the function CST and current function symbol; captured expression checking retains self.span, and infer_ctx.rs alloc_expr stores the supplied RelativeSpan unchanged. Zero-width relative intervals remain zero-width through the same arithmetic; macro ParseSource identity is preserved rather than translated to call-site text. No production behavioral change was made. Added essential associations in parse/items.rs, parse/util.rs, local_syms/associated.rs, and check/infer_ctx.rs so these obligations are represented in future review inputs.

Test adequacy is explicitly partial. moving_associated_items_preserves_symbol_query_keys has twelve trait/impl function/type/const insertion/reorder scenarios, runs each edit forward and backward, checks associated owner identity, and asserts the observer does not rerun. These are substantive symbol stability assertions, but they do not assert coordinates and would not alone detect an incorrect node origin or missing addition. types_spans_relative_composition remains an honest TODO, not a passing behavioral test: its prerequisite is completion of the attributes/signatures/bodies/associated/error/zero-width/generated-text coordinate fixtures before and after item/sibling movement. That explicit fixture deferral accounts for the missing direct coordinate coverage; this review accepts the visible deferral and does not claim those scenarios are tested. No N/A or implementation TODO entries exist. Source inspection supports the represented composition paths; comprehensive coordinate regression coverage remains deferred as stated.

Executed cargo fmt and cargo test -p sage-test-harness moving_associated_items_preserves_symbol_query_keys --lib: one test passed. Also ran cargo build (result reported separately to coordinator). Fresh start after association edits and review read captured the additional dependencies. Centralized delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks are assigned to the coordinator for the comment-only edits.
